ADEA.name: Account Servicer Deadline Missed
ADEA.definition: Received after the account servicer's deadline.

DCAL.name: Call Denied Since Already Applied
DCAL.definition: Repo call request was denied since another call already applies.

DFOR.name: Denied Since Not Allowed
DFOR.definition: Repo call request was denied. Call not allowed on the concerned repo, for example, out of delay.
